name: Treat Croissant Vanilla
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), SUGAR, REFINED PALM OIL & INTERESTERIFIED VEGETABLE FAT, MARGARINE, LIQUID GLUCOSE, MILK SOLIDS, BAKERY IMPROVER MIX {EMULSIFIERS [481(i) & 471], ANTICAKING AGENT [170(i)], FLOUR TREATMENT AGENTS [1100(i) & 1101(i)] & ANTIOXIDANT (300)}, HUMECTANT [420(ii)], YEAST, VITAL GLUTEN, EMULSIFIERS (471 & 475), IODISED SALT, PRESERVATIVES (282 & 202), NATURE IDENTICAL (VANILLA) FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES, COLOUR (171), RAISING AGENTS [450(i) & 338] AND STABILIZER (469).
